defects.what: The hand holding the medallion is a smooth mitten with no separate fingers, and the medallion sits pasted flat on the palm.

defects.note: Redrawn: a two-wheeled calesa seen from behind, the pony pulling it by harness and shafts, the boy holding the reins, no mirrors, no handlebars.

fix_note: Fixed on the owning machine. 20 stills were redrawn with the full-quality engine and one shot (k21) was reframed. Each kept picture was chosen from up to four tries and passed at full size and at 3x. indio_cheer was redrawn a second time in this pass. The originals are kept in the scratch folder until the episode is rebuilt. Of the 19 must-fix entries, 19 are fixed. Not fixed: three minor entries (k15 outfit, k15 fists, k29 chin hand).
